title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — actual never inside us; tip before three senses
pass_a_gloss: I reply also that by that imputation Adam's past actual never was, nor can be, inside us. I reply finally that imputation is either (a) an act of the divine mind/judgment reckoning us guilty of that Adamic deed, or (b) a declaration of that judgment by external sentence, or (c) the infliction of penalty. Tip before working those three.
pass_b_english: I reply also, that by that imputation it does not come about that the actual sin, or that past action of Adam, ever was inside us, or can be. I reply finally that imputation is either an action of the mind or of the divine judgment reckoning us to be guilty of that Adamic action, or a declaration of that divine judgment by a sentence passed in external speech, or the infliction of penalty.
source_text: Repono etiam, non fieri imputatione illa ut peccatum actuale, seu actio illa praeterita Adami, unquam intra nos fuerit, aut esse possit. Repono denique imputationem, aut esse actionem mentis seu iudicii divini reputantis nos esse reos actionis illius Adamicae, aut illius divini iudicii declarationem lata sententia sermone externo, aut poenae inflictionem.

choices.choice: Actual never inside us; tip before three senses of imputation
